info.description: Browser API implemented locally with explicit v2 enablement. Fictional inventory; no payments. Registration remains CLOSED except the explicit test gate. Admin catalogue/media use ADMIN session+CSRF. See ../API_CONTRACT.md.

post.summary: Quote authenticated user selection without a hold
post.description: Owner+QUOTE+key fingerprint of room/dates/guests. 10-min non-sliding expiry. Same key/body within 24h replays same original quote/expiry if still valid; if expired 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED, never silently renew. New key requests a new quote. Wrong payload 409. Retain quote recovery record 24h, then purge; reuse after retention can only recalculate, never create booking.

post.description: Fresh key requires full body; known success can be replayed with header ONLY, no body or quote. Resolve existing operation before quote expiry/date/catalog validation; compare canonical payload if supplied. Under durable operation-row then room lock, recheck availability, capacity, price/terms and deadline; atomic booking+outbox+success receipt. Same key with new quoteToken is a conflict. No implicit reconfirmation. Immutable receipt statusAtCreation is not current booking status. After locking the operation row, worker MUST re-read state and attemptToken/lease: terminal SUCCEEDED/FAILED stops creation; only its own PROCESSING unexpired lease may begin. Recovery makes terminal states irreversible; a delayed worker cannot resurrect REQUEST_ABORTED.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: true when the original stored receipt was returned.

get.summary: Resolve uncertain creation result by original key
get.description: 200 PROCESSING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED. 404 only no operation for current user/key, not proof no request is still in flight; retry original key, never invent a replacement based on 404. No quote/body required; key travels in Idempotency-Key header, never URL or analytics/access logs. Successful records and terminal key bindings retained with history, no expiry. Failed full error expires in 7 days but terminal code/fingerprint persist.

post.summary: Resolve or fence an unaccepted original operation
post.description: Explicit recovery action after unknown/404 result and lost quote. Atomically read existing owner+CREATE_BOOKING+key; return its status. If absent insert durable FAILED REQUEST_ABORTED tombstone, unique with create reservation; late original POST can never create on this key. Does not cancel a committed booking or abort a locked PROCESSING transaction. PROCESSING still requires polling. No request body or expired quote required.

post.summary: Cancel own booking before saved local deadline
post.description: No body/key needed: durable CONFIRMED->CANCELLED transition itself idempotent. Lock room, re-read booking status, check owner and now<saved deadline. Already CANCELLED returns 200 with original cancelledAt even after deadline. 409 CANCELLATION_CLOSED or LEGACY_TIMEZONE_UNKNOWN. Cancellation and outbox event atomic. Never delete or restore history.

Id.description: Positive Java Long serialized as decimal string; <=9223372036854775807. No leading zeros.

LocalDate.description: Hotel-local calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, never converted to/from a browser UTC timestamp.

Instant.description: UTC instant ending Z. Deadline is also accompanied by its saved IANA time zone.

TimeZone.description: An explicit valid IANA zone; examples Europe/Moscow, Asia/Vladivostok. No implicit default for legacy hotels.

Money.description: Non-negative base-10 RUB amount, exactly two fraction digits. No exponent, separators, float or implicit rounding. Max 999999999999.99; catalog nightly prices capped at 9999999999.99 so 30-night totals fit.

IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUIDv4, lower-case canonical spelling; owner+operation scoped, never a credential.

Pricing.description: Fixed room price × calendar nights. All fees are zero/included; no payments, extra taxes, discounts or per-person tariffs.

Stay.description: One physical room; guests <= room.capacity. Both dates required, 1..30 nights, hotel-local tomorrow..today+365 inclusive for checkout.

Photo.description: Only reviewed local media URLs, rights/credit and Russian alt. No arbitrary remote URL fetch.

HotelCard.description: No owner IDs, user data, guest data or per-booking unavailable date arrays. Without dates fromPrice.nights=1 is an indicative nightly price, not a quote.

HotelDetail.description: Detail metadata is independent of current room availability. No inline price or room availability; query rooms separately.

Room.description: NOT_EVALUATED without dates, pricing.nights=1 indicative; no reservation hold. Single-room GET may report CAPACITY_EXCEEDED; list filters capacity >= guests.

SearchWarning.description: Multi-city search can exclude hotels outside hotel-local horizon. Never changes requested dates. If all candidate zones are invalid, 400 DATE_RANGE_INVALID instead.

HotelPage.description: Zero-based offset pagination; empty or out-of-range page returns 200 empty items. Sort has mandatory stable ID tiebreak; counts reflect one database snapshot, not a reservation.

RoomPage.description: Zero-based offset pagination; empty or out-of-range page returns 200 empty items. Sort has mandatory stable ID tiebreak; counts reflect one database snapshot, not a reservation.

UserProfile.description: Only current authenticated user; registration response is only the account just created. Never included in public catalog DTO.

SessionInfo.description: Idle 30 minutes; absolute 12 hours. No session identifier or auth token in JSON.

CsrfInfo.description: Anonymous or current-session token, in memory only, valid 30 minutes or until session/login/logout rotation. Does not authenticate. CLOSED is production default until email verification/recovery exist.

LoginRequest.description: Username login, not implicit email. UTF-8 password <=72 bytes. Existing password semantics preserved; login does not apply new-signup minimum length.

RegisterRequest.description: TEST_ONLY explicitly enabled isolated environment only; password <=72 UTF-8 bytes. Server sets USER and emailVerified=false. No role, returnUrl or verification claim accepted.

QuoteRequest.description: One physical room; guests <= room.capacity. Both dates required, 1..30 nights, hotel-local tomorrow..today+365 inclusive for checkout.

QuoteSnapshot.description: Display facts and IANA zone captured at booking commit. No user name/email; no promise of historical data for legacy rows.

quoteToken.description: Opaque 256-bit server token bound to owner, stay and terms. Store SHA-256 server-side, not raw token in logs.

Quote.description: Valid for 10 minutes by server time, non-sliding. Not a price/availability lock. Any total/price/currency/cancellation/TZ term change before commit requires explicit reconfirmation.

quoteToken.description: Opaque 256-bit server token bound to owner, stay and terms. Store SHA-256 server-side, not raw token in logs.

CreateBookingRequest.description: No userId or client money. Full canonical payload includes quoteToken; changing only the token changes the idempotency fingerprint. Body optional ONLY for known operation replay; fresh operations require all fields.

Cancellation.description: Evaluate server time after acquiring room lock: now < saved local check-in day start. CANCELLED repeat succeeds even past deadline. Legacy with unknown zone cannot self-cancel.

NewBooking.description: All saved commercial/display facts immutable after commit, including cancellation zone/deadline; mutable only status/cancelledAt. No payment state.

LegacyBooking.description: Never reconstruct historical price, guests, createdAt, names or address from current catalog. Original room and dates retained; CONFIRMED until explicitly cancelled. Verified per-record timezone may supply cancellation rules, otherwise no self-cancel.

BookingPage.description: Zero-based offset pagination; empty or out-of-range page returns 200 empty items. Sort has mandatory stable ID tiebreak; counts reflect one database snapshot, not a reservation.

BookingCreationReceipt.description: Immutable original success receipt, not current status. Same receipt on replay even if booking was later cancelled; GET bookingUrl for current status. Retained with booking history; no quote required to recover it.

FieldError.description: Safe localized text, no rejected values; field uses JSON field or query parameter name, no full URL.

ErrorDetails.description: Only documented safe details. replacementQuote is advisory and may expire; no auto-submission. No arbitrary exception metadata.

ApiError.description: Stable code drives client behavior; Russian message may change. No stack trace, rejected values, request query, credentials or another owner identifier.

ProcessingOperation.description: Durable reservation accepted, final transaction not yet resolved. No success/failure claim. Lease 30 seconds is NOT proof of failure.

FailedOperation.description: Known no booking committed. Full error body retained 7 days, then null with durable terminal errorCode/fingerprint; key never reusable. Fetch a new quote and ask again before a new create key.

NightlyPrice.description: Non-negative nightly RUB amount, exactly two decimals, max 9999999999.99. Fixed room tariff; 30-night total fits Money.

nightlyPrice.description: Strictly positive exact RUB decimal; no rounding.
Strictly positive exact RUB decimal; no rounding.

MinPrice.description: Inclusive nightly price filter, RUB, not stay total.

PriceSort.name: sort
PriceSort.description: priceAsc: matched minimum price ASC,id ASC; priceDesc: same price DESC,id ASC; idAsc: numeric id ASC.

CityCode.name: city
CityCode.description: Canonical code from cities. Unknown code is 400, not guessed text matching.

Slug.name: slug
Slug.description: Immutable canonical slug; hidden/missing hotel returns 404.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: QUOTE or CREATE_BOOKING operation namespace. Full normalized payload bound durably; see API_CONTRACT.md.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
csrf.description: Required on every unsafe v2 operation, including login/register/logout. Obtain via GET auth/csrf. Strict same-origin; no non-browser Basic exemption.

400.description: Invalid fields, dates, key or malformed JSON. No booking.
